stem: A chemist has 15 liters of a solution that is \(10\%\) acid by volume. How many liters of a solution that is \(40\%\) acid by volume must be added to make a solution that is \(30\%\) acid by volume?
solution: Let \(v\) be the liters added. Acid: \(0.1 \cdot 15 + 0.4v = 1.5 + 0.4v\).
verify:
v = symbols('v')
ans = solve(Eq(Rational(1, 10)*15 + Rational(4, 10)*v, Rational(3, 10)*(15 + v)), v)[0]
assert ans == 30
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
